text: {"lessons":["Scaling out of Stock B and D at gains realized profits, but I should weigh the remaining upside and portfolio balance rather than sell only because a position feels like a separate winning account.","My account value fluctuated despite profitable sales, so I should assess total-portfolio performance and risk, not let realized gains create false reassurance.","After buying Stock A and E, I held through several periods and added to A; future buys should be based on current prospects and diversification, not simply familiarity or recent price history."]}
